title: test(cli): spawn the CLI source entry with node, not the tsx binary, in 76 test files
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XCHfAmysCiUnEeJgGTefeZA)_

Part of #23181 (slice 34). The card stays open for later slices: this one takes only the tsx → `process.execPath` lever on the 78 `packages/cli` test files in the order's list.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`packages/cli` 里 76 个测试文件起 CLI 源码入口 `bin/run-dev.js` 时，不再经 `node_modules/.bin/tsx` 包装层，改为直接用 `process.execPath`（测试自己的 node）起同一个入口，与 migrate 系列（slice 12）、slice 25、slice 28 已有写法一致。其中 23 个文件还改正了因此变假的注释。清单里其余 2 个文件保留 tsx，原因见下。
- **为什么改**：卡 #23181 的测试提速职责。tsx 包装层是多出来的一个 node 进程加一次转译；入口文件、`src/`、`NODE_ENV=development` 两种起法都一样（oclif 在 development 下自己在进程内注册 tsx，把命令树映射到 `src/`，已用 debug 日志实测）。A/B 六个文件，每个快 25%–43%。
- **风险与回滚**：只改测试文件，不发布任何东西（cli 的 `files[]` 只有 dist、README、CHANGELOG）；没有删、没有放宽任何断言，用例名和数量不变，层级划分不变；回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/cli/test/verify-json-stdout.test.ts`（改正了"纯 node 会从 dist 读命令"这句错注释）；`packages/cli/test/serve-publishes-bound-port.e2e.test.ts`（进程组清理的注释，不再有 tsx 孙进程）；`packages/cli/test/diff-usage-error-stream.e2e.test.ts`（唯一一处断言改动：对照用例检查的启动器从 tsx 换成 `process.execPath`）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project integration test/verify-json-stdout.test.ts test/generate-refuses-retired-generator.test.ts` → 11/11 通过。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**Sort.** The order's list (`pm-orders/server/evidence/23181-s34/files.txt`) re-derived on base `7449e479c4`: `git grep -lw TSX` over `packages/cli` gives 131 paths; minus `test/helpers/**`, the 53 left over are every file slices 24–33 own plus two non-test sources (`src/utils/authored-source-codemod.ts`, `vitest-tiers.ts`). So the list is exactly the 78 files, no difference. One note on the order's wording: 33 of the 78 import `TSX` from `test/helpers/serve-process.ts`; the other 45 declare their own `const TSX = resolve(…, 'node_modules/.bin/tsx')`. Both spawn the same way.

| bucket | files | what happens |
|:--|--:|:--|
| (a) spawns `bin/run-dev.js` through the tsx binary, and the test is not about that launcher | 76 | switched to `process.execPath` |
| (b) already on `process.execPath`, tsx only in prose | 0 | none |
| (c) keeps tsx | 2 | `run-dev-unbuilt-workspace.e2e`: it pins `bin/run-dev.js`'s own stderr drain and EPIPE survival, and the shim's header measures that listener shape under tsx (tsx's hooks worker pipes into `process.stderr`, so Console's keep-alive is never installed); it also drives the run with a `--import` hook through `NODE_OPTIONS`. `serve-host-fallback-base.e2e`: its child is not the CLI entry but a `probe.mjs` that imports `src/commands/serve.ts` directly, which needs the tsx loader (the slice 25 reading: no gain for a `.ts` helper child) |

**The switch, bucket (a).** Every spawn site passes `process.execPath` where it passed `TSX`, with `bin/run-dev.js` still the first argument; the child env, cwd, argv, stdio and timeouts are unchanged. A local `TSX` constant is removed; a helper import drops `TSX` (the export stays). Spawn shapes covered: `spawn`, `spawnSync`, `execFile`, `execFileSync`, promisified `execFile`, the files' own `run(file, …)` wrappers, the `script(1)` command line of the two login NDJSON files, the `os` shell shim in `i18n-extract-check-hint`, and the `{ exec, argv }` entry of `start-port-banner-agreement`'s auto-shift leg. The three generate files' `runTsx` helper is now `runCli`.

**Why the child is the same.** `bin/run-dev.js` pins `NODE_ENV=development`; under it @oclif/core 5.1.2 (`config/ts-path.js`) registers tsx in-process and maps `dist/commands` to `src/commands`, with `packages/cli/dist` built or not. Probe on this branch with `dist/` built: `DEBUG='*ts-path*' node bin/run-dev.js --version` logs `registering tsx at …/packages/cli`, `Successfully imported tsx` and `Found source directory for …/dist/commands at …/src/commands` (`pm-orders/server/evidence/23181-s34/oclif-ts-path-probe.txt`). The entry's own static `../src/utils/*.ts` imports load through Node 22's type stripping (`.nvmrc` = 22), as on the slice 12 files.

**Prose that became false**, corrected in 23 files: the eight `verify-*` files said plain node makes oclif resolve the command from `dist/` (the probe above says otherwise); `serve-publishes-bound-port`, `serve-port-drift-notice` and `package-install-local-jobs-shared-name` described a tsx shim with the CLI in a grandchild; the rest said "spawns the CLI through `tsx`", "cold `tsx` starts" or "`bin/run-dev.js` + tsx". Prose that stays true is unchanged ("`src/` through tsx", "oclif + tsx cold start", quotes of `bin/run-dev.js`'s header). The `// test-budget:` headers of the six `package-install-local-*` files still say "the tsx source entry"; this slice does not touch headers.

The one assertion edit: `diff-usage-error-stream`'s control case `resolves the dev entry it drives` checked `existsSync(TSX)`; it now checks `existsSync(process.execPath)`, the launcher it drives. Same meaning.

Not changed: no case name, case count, timeout, tier, project or `// test-budget:` header; no file under `test/helpers/**`; no source file.

## Tests

- **All 76 switched files pass on `6410254c`** (the fix commits, before the merge). Queue tier: `vitest run --project integration --maxWorkers=2` over the 29 non-`.e2e` files: 29/29 files, 213/213 tests. Nightly tier (`OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly`), the 47 `.e2e` files: 47/47 files, 671/671 tests. Lock VERDICT command-exit 0 on both.
- **Tiers unchanged.** `tierSignals` from `packages/cli/vitest-tiers.ts` on all 78 files before and after: 78 `integration`, identical. The switched files still import or name `CLI` / `run-dev.js`.
- **A/B**, six files over six commands. Head `6410254c` vs base `7449e479c4`, one box, one lock hold, N=3, `--maxWorkers=1`. Base bytes swapped into the same path (blob hash checked) so both legs keep the same tier and config; each leg its own vitest invocation, order alternated per round; restored from `HEAD` and `git diff HEAD` empty after. Reading: the default reporter's per-file line. Every leg exit 0, same test counts per side.

  | file | base (s) | head (s) | change |
  |:--|:--|:--|--:|
  | `generate-refuses-retired-generator` | 6.52, 6.73, 6.03 | 4.73, 4.80, 4.95 | -24.9% (mean 6.43 → 4.82) |
  | `verify-json-stdout` | 22.06, 23.04, 23.01 | 14.86, 14.73, 16.12 | -32.9% (mean 22.70 → 15.24) |
  | `serve-migrate-exit-schema-parity.integration` | 21.30, 21.44, 20.36 | 13.39, 12.90, 13.21 | -37.4% (mean 21.04 → 13.17) |
  | `i18n-check-platform-bucket.e2e` | 47.01, 44.79, 45.16 | 26.01, 26.19, 26.61 | -42.5% (mean 45.65 → 26.27) |
  | `login-json-ndjson.e2e` | 20.21, 19.73, 20.03 | 12.37, 12.83, 12.84 | -36.6% (mean 19.99 → 12.68) |
  | `requires-retired-capability.e2e` | 18.34, 18.64, 16.96 | 10.60, 10.44, 11.30 | -40.0% (mean 17.98 → 10.78) |

  Raw legs and the script: `pm-orders/server/evidence/23181-s34/ab-summary.txt`, `ab.sh`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` (tsc and `check:test-typecheck`, which compiles the test layer under `tsconfig.test.json`) exit 0 on `6410254c`, with `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096`; the debt ledger is unchanged (3 files, 28 errors, 6 pinned signatures). `eslint --no-inline-config` over the 76 files exit 0 (`@objectstack/cli` has no `lint` script).
- No ablation: no tested behaviour changed (test-only).

## Acceptance notes

- **Out of scope, for a later helper slice.** The helper's own `serve` spawn (`test/helpers/serve-process.ts`, `runServe()`, around line 982) still goes through `TSX`. 12 test files call `runServe(` in code position: `artifact-pinned-boot.e2e`, `serve-app-runtime-hooks.e2e`, `serve-boot-diagnostics-noise-budget.e2e`, `serve-boot-diagnostics.e2e`, `serve-cluster-driver-diagnosis.e2e`, `serve-no-artifact.e2e`, `serve-organizations-host-resolution.e2e`, `serve-organizations-mount-failure.e2e`, `serve-package-declared-capabilities`, `serve-package-registry-always-on.e2e`, `serve-port-readback.e2e`, `uncreatable-directory-doors.integration`. Carrier: #23181.
- **`skip-changeset`.** Test-only. `@objectstack/cli`'s `files[]` is `dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`; its build emits no `*.test.ts` into `dist/`. No `files[]` content changes.

## Verification

Head `95b877c4`: the two fix commits `106e7364` (the switch) and `6410254c` (the prose), plus one merge of `origin/main` after slices 24 (#28610), 26 (#28599) and 28 (#28616) landed, as the order asks. The merge touches none of the 78 files and nothing under `test/helpers/**`.

- After the merge: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build` (117/117 tasks), then the 29 queue-tier switched files again: 29/29 files, 213/213 tests. The 47 nightly files, the A/B and the typecheck above were taken on `6410254c`.
- Derived gates (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on `95b877c4`, the same 48 as before the merge): 48/48 exit 0, exit codes captured before any pipe. `--ran` reconcile: 48 accounted, 48 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, exit 0 (`pm-orders/server/evidence/23181-s34/gates-ran-95b877c4.txt`). Prerequisites: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` after fetching its control commit; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` after the full build.
- By hand: `check-commit-card-trailers --range origin/main..HEAD` exit 0; `check-nul-bytes` exit 0.
- CI: the PR's check-runs are the seat's reading.
